===Overview===
The Lions of Adelmar were raised by [[Raise Dawnish army Summer 385YE|Senate motion]] proposed by '''Bohemond de Rondell''', then Senator for Astolat, during the Summer Solstice 385YE. [[Love and War|Mustering]] completed shortly before the Spring Equinox 387YE, having been funded in large part by Emperor '''Vesna Borkovna Prochnost''' using [[The_Throne#The_Hand_of_the_Chancellor|the Hand of the Chancellor]]. The incumbent senator for Astolat, '''Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco''', named the army after the exemplar [[Adelmar the Lion]] and endorsed the army's focus on [[Dawn_hearth_magic#Love_and_Flowers|love]]. 

The fourth Dawnish general leads the Lions of Adelmar army, and is appointed (or re-appointed) at the Winter Solstice each year.
